header: A new file collection permission in Microsoft Defender XDR Unified RBAC is now in Public Preview
content:
Unified RBAC is now in Public Preview
You can now assign a new granular permission in Microsoft Defender XDR Unified RBAC that
allows users to collect or download files for analysis. This permission enables Microsoft
Defender for Endpoint users download files directly from the file page and during a live
response investigation in the live response console. You can add the new permission to a
custom role by selecting it from the Security operations permissions group when creating the
role. For more information, see Create custom roles with Microsoft Defender XDR Unified
RBAC.
